newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-BPI rates Vitarich a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BPI rates Vitarich a hold.

text.p: BPI Securities recommended a hold on poultry producer Vitarich Corp as the company is expected to improve its profitability next year, BPI analyst Spencer Yap said in a research paper released on Wednesday.
At present, Vitarich is suffering due to a glut of supply in the market and higher feed prices, he said.
Yap said concerted efforts by chicken producers to curb production volume would take months before the effect could be felt by the market.
"We can definitely see improvements in profitability for most producers next year (given the depths that corporate earnings have fallen this year)," Yap said.
Nevertheless, he said the company would be hard pressed to regain former profit levels unless chicken prices improve significantly.
